understand-letter-or-form.label: Understand a letter or form
understand-letter-or-form.assistantMessage: Paste the letter or form here, or tell me what it says and what part feels confusing. I can help you read it in plain language.
suggestions: Tell me what this is asking for
Show me the deadline or next step
Help me answer it

write-something.label: Write something
write-something.assistantMessage: Tell me who it's for, what you need to say, and how direct or polite you want it to sound. I can help you draft it.
suggestions: Write a text message
Write an email
Help me say this clearly

think-it-through.label: Think it through (listen and ask questions)
think-it-through.assistantMessage: Tell me what's going on. I can listen, ask a few questions, and help you sort out what matters first.
suggestions: Ask me questions one at a time
Help me sort this out
Help me make a plan

figure-out-next.label: Figure out what to do next
figure-out-next.assistantMessage: Tell me the situation and where you're stuck. I can help you narrow it down to the smallest useful next step.
suggestions: Help me choose what to do first
Give me the smallest next step
I have too many problems at once

explain-like-new.label: Explain something like I'm new to it
explain-like-new.assistantMessage: Tell me what you want explained. I will keep it simple and clear without talking down to you.
suggestions: Explain this in simple words
Explain the main idea first
Tell me what this means for me

prepare-for-hard.label: Prepare for something hard
prepare-for-hard.assistantMessage: Tell me what the hard thing is. We can work on what to say, what to bring, or what to expect.
suggestions: Help me prepare what to say
Make a short plan with me
What should I bring or ask

am-i-being-unreasonable.label: Am I being unreasonable
am-i-being-unreasonable.assistantMessage: Tell me what happened and what you're asking for. I'll be direct with you, even if the answer is uncomfortable.
suggestions: Tell me straight
What am I missing here
How would this sound to someone else

embarrassed-to-ask.label: Something I'm embarrassed to ask
embarrassed-to-ask.assistantMessage: Ask it the way it comes to you. I won't make it weird or judge you.
suggestions: I don't know how to ask this
I feel dumb asking this
Please explain without judging me

type-your-own.label: Type your own
type-your-own.assistantMessage: Type whatever you want help with. A question, a letter, a situation, or just a few words is enough to start.
suggestions: Help me explain my situation
Help me write something
Help me figure out what to do next

talk-instead.label: Talk instead
talk-instead.assistantMessage: You can use the mic when it's available. For now, type a few words and I can still help you get started.
suggestions: I want to say this out loud
Help me start with one sentence
Ask me one question first
